root_cause_label: Omitted chsh Command to Change Default Shell to Zsh
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent successfully installed zsh, oh-my-zsh, configured the apple theme, added all required plugins, installed Miniconda, and set up the terminal-bench conda environment, but never executed `chsh -s /usr/bin/zsh` to change the default shell to zsh as explicitly required by the task spec, and stopped without emitting a completion signal.
t_err_evidence: At step 4, the agent proceeds to install oh-my-zsh immediately after zsh is installed (step 3), skipping the `chsh -s /usr/bin/zsh` command that should have changed the default shell. The agent's plan never includes this requirement, revealing spec_neglect from the outset.
t_commit_evidence: At step 19, the agent appends `conda activate terminal-bench` to .bashrc and stops entirely with no indication of returning to run chsh. The trajectory ends here with the chsh step permanently missing.
trigger_explanation: The task explicitly requires changing the default shell to zsh via `chsh -s /usr/bin/zsh`, but the agent never included this in its plan or execution. The agent proceeded through all other setup steps (zsh install, oh-my-zsh, plugins, theme, conda) without ever considering the chsh requirement, indicating it either never read or dropped this part of the task specification.
